fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled checkpoint found. The site sits in open farm fields with no perimeter security fence; the access road off the E-side public road shows no barrier arm and no guard booth. Classified false, medium confidence. Note: Street View coverage of the immediate plant driveway is sparse (ZERO_RESULTS at several nearby points); call relies mainly on satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed-booth structure visible at the entrance in satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A single long dock bank runs the south face of the 557,533 sq ft building with trailers backed in along its length; estimate ~65 doors from z18 imagery — 50+ band confident.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A long row of marked trailer-parking stalls on the south apron holds many trailers without tractors; 50+ band, dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors are on one continuous south face; ship and receive share the same dock bank — not separate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide access road and broad apron with abundant unused paved width leave clear room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved yard between the access road and the dock doors provides internal post-gate staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs near the highway interchange NW of the plant, but no spur enters the Niagara property; classified not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits in an isolated edge-of-Seguin industrial area surrounded by open farm fields — Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is somewhat isolated but lies in an active industrial park beside a highway interchange, so cellular coverage is likely adequate; left false but flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~32 acres derived from the perimeter box, consistent with the ~30-acre figure in the Seguin EDC listing.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single Niagara building; other large buildings nearby (NE/E) belong to separate companies and are excluded.

verification.rationale: Operating since 2016 (Rio Nogales Dr), expanded 2019, hiring through 2025-26; no TX closure/WARN. Self-operated.
